$comment: The rooms of Storykeeper Castle the server will record a child discovering (SC-R03-06). The ids are a save-compatibility contract shared with react/src/features/island-map/three/castleLayout.ts (CASTLE_ROOM_IDS); a Vitest test fails if the two lists differ. Rooms are only ever appended. A secret room is recorded only once the discovery it names is on the child's world state, so the server never confirms a secret exists to a child who has not found it.
